rule_title: W-9 Legal Name vs COI Insured Name
description: Matches W-9 entity name to COI policy holder name using fuzzy matching (similarity >= 70%).

rule_title: W-9 Legal Name vs Bank Account Name
description: Verifies that the legal entity name matches the bank account name (similarity >= 70%).
Verifies the policy expiration date on the Certificate of Insurance is greater than the current SYSTEM_DATE.
Confirms General Liability Per Occurrence is >= COI_MIN_LIABILITY_USD ($1000000).
Validates the presence of cyber insurance coverage.
Flags policies set to expire within COI_EXPIRY_WARNING_DAYS (30 days) of SYSTEM_DATE.

rule_title: W-9 Legal Name vs Company Registration Name
description: Compares the W-9 legal entity name to the officially registered company name (similarity >= 70%).

rule_title: Bank Account Name vs Bank Beneficiary Name
description: Verifies the account name matches the listed bank beneficiary name (similarity >= 70%).
Cross-checks the state of incorporation between the W-9 form and the state registration document.
Validates that the signature is present and filled on the W-9 tax form.
